product.title: WAR ROOM — NBA Decision Simulator
product.summary: Follow the model, adjust it, or override it — and find out.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students face real analytics scenarios where a confidence-scored projection meets a situation the model cannot see. For each they must flag at least two fragile assumptions, then follow, adjust or override the model with a typed rationale, before the real outcome and their streak are revealed.

studentDataProfile.notes: Collects name and email client-side for the completion code; no network call observed.

governance.maturityBasis: Fifteen fully authored scenarios with individual outcome text. No student-run evidence exists.

health.technicalBasis: GitHub Pages returned 200 on 2026-08-14. Reachability only.
knownBlockers: Asks the student for an email address before play begins.

publicRelease.holdReason: The landing screen asks for a name and an email address before play begins (input#playerEmail, for a completion code). Whether BOW points an unsupervised public visitor at that is a decision for a human, not a build script.

provenance.evidence: 301-M4-L1/index.html hero copy: 'Analytics just dropped their projection. The numbers say one thing. The situation says another.' Scenarios carry modelConfidence and fragility-scored factors.
